desc: Take your personal safety seriously with the powerful Mace Brand Compact Model Pepper Spray. The Black canister is compact, easy to use, and gives you control and confidence when you need it. Plus, the proprietary flip-top prevents accidental discharge. With direct contact to the face, Mace Brand pepper spray causes an assailant's eyes to slam shut. It also induces coughing, as the spray affects the respiratory system as well as leaves an intense burning sensation to the eyes. This gives you time you need to get away to safety.
